title: Vadim Yatsenko: Splitting the Read-Only Transaction: Replica Reads Inside an Open Transaction
excerpt: Read/write splitting is easy for single, autocommit statements. It gets hard the moment a client opens a transaction. Most proxies give up and send every statement inside a transaction to the primary, even the reads. This article is about a middle path we built into Polar Proxy: keep the transaction on the primary, but let its read statements borrow a replica connection.

title: AWS Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, With On Demand Headroom Reserved
excerpt:
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS’s large committed cloud capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with part of 2028 already allocated, while the company continues to reserve headroom for On Demand, EC2 and Bedrock. Practitioners discussing the remarks report difficulty obtaining On Demand capacity for ordinary EC2 instances, and similar constraints at other providers.
By Steef-Jan Wiggers

title: File Mover Express: AWS Releases Open-Source Tool for S3 File Transfers
excerpt:
AWS has recently released File Mover Express, an open-source application under the Apache 2.0 license for transferring large files between local systems and Amazon S3. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux, it supports parallel transfers, automatic performance tuning, retries, pause and resume, and file integrity verification.
By Renato Losio
